items.title: Bhotekoshi flood sweeps away nine bank branches, 26 staff out of contact
items.summary: Nine commercial bank branches in Rasuwa were swept away by the flood, while communication disruptions have made it difficult to contact employees working there, the Nepal Bankers’ Association said.

items.title: What we know about the Bhotekoshi flood so far
items.summary: The death toll has climbed to 22, nearly 400 remain missing and 88 have been rescued. Inclement weather and disruptions in communication have hampered search-and-rescue efforts.

items.summary: The NEPSE index fell 35.92 points, or 1.38 percent, as shares of hydropower and non-life insurance companies came under heavy selling pressure following reports of flood damage to projects in Rasuwa.

items.title: UPDATE: Rasuwa flood death toll climbs to 22 as dozens remain missing
